import urllib.request,urllib.error,http.cookiejar,json
base='https://app.ontrackegy.com/ayo/'
client=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(http.cookiejar.CookieJar()))
checks=[]
for name,markers in [('',[b'id="gatewayTestButton"',b'app.js?v=12']),('app.js?v=12',[b'copyToChannel(data,0)',b'async function testGateway']),('style.css?v=12',[b'gateway-test-result']),('api.php?action=status',[])]:
 with client.open(urllib.request.Request(base+name,headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache'}),timeout=9) as r:
  b=r.read(200000)
  passed=all(x in b for x in markers)
  checks.append({'path':name or '/','http':r.status,'markers_ok':passed,'bytes':len(b)})
  if name=='':checks[-1]['permissions_policy']=r.headers.get('Permissions-Policy','')
  if name.startswith('api.php'):
   data=json.loads(b);checks[-1]['owner_guarded']=not data.get('ownerAuthorized',False)
   checks[-1]['keys_not_public']=not any(x in data.get('config',{}) for x in ('inworldKey','omniraKey','apinexKey'))
passAll=all(x['http']==200 and x['markers_ok'] for x in checks)
print(json.dumps({'result':'PASS' if passAll else 'FAIL','checks':checks}))
if not passAll:raise RuntimeError('HTTP smoke failed')
